Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying {U}{U}, causing it to enter with vanishing 3 as a copy of Muldrotha.
Put the original Muldrotha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard using the new Muldrotha by paying {0}.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any one color.
Cast Last Voyage of the ______ by paying {3}{B}.
When Last Voyage of the ______ enters, it triggers, becoming an Aura and returning Muldrotha from your graveyard to the battlefield with Last Voyage of the ______ attached to it.

765-1238-8323-8324.easyPrerequisites: You're able to play a land this turn.
765-1238-8323-8324.description:
Play Guildless Commons
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Avatar of Burgeoning Echoes trigger, causing you to create a Jace planeswalker token and put two loyalty counters on it.
Activate the Jace token by removing a loyalty counter from it.
Way of the Paradox triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and allowing you to play another land this turn.
Resolve the Jace token's ability, causing you to surveil 1.
Activate Heart of Kiran's crew ability by removing a loyalty counter from the Jace token.
The Jace token is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having no loyalty.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability.
Repeat.

2872-4613-6859.easyPrerequisites:
Servant of Tymaret doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.

2872-4613-6859.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2872-4613-6859.description:
Activate Servant of Tymaret using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Servant of Tymaret
Servant of Tymaret triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain that much life.
Repeat.

Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Isochron Scepter.
Repeat.

1170-3581-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3581-5131-5330--202.description:

Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4050-5035-5104.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
4050-5035-5104.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat each combat phase.
1115-3259-7605.notes: Afterwards, you can cast Excess from your graveyard for {1}{R} to create Treasures.

When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the persist creature trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

When the Treasure token enters the battlefield, Builder's Talent's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Repeat.

864-957-2061.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

Activate the Vehicle's crew ability by tapping Saint Traft and Rem Karolus.
Saint Traft and Rem Karolus triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two of the creature tokens, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Saint Traft and Rem Karolus by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Saint Traft and Rem Karolus enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Saint Traft and Rem Karolus.
Repeat.

974-2487-2645-3008.notablePrerequisites:
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
Flamewright does not have summoning sickness.
974-2487-2645-3008.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Flamewright's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Construct creature token.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Construct token.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing the Construct to become a copy of Smaug for as long as Blade of Shared Souls is attached to it.
Put the Construct token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Construct dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {7}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Flamewright.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite mana, you may simply tap and untap Flamewright to get infinite Construct tokens, and then use its second ability to sacrifice them for infinite damage.
You may also use the mana to activate any of Staff of Domination's abilities.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur, adding {W}.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its second ability and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, creating at least four 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing four Citizens, adding {4}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more creatures to start the combo, this combo will net infinite Citizen tokens, infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur and infinite colored mana.

Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Dragon token, adding {R}.
